messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on hiring & org changes — a few folks pinged me about how the Q3 headcount maps to the new bands and what managers should do about backfills. I'll collect Qs here so we can post a short playbook.

Jonas (CTO): TL;DR: we're adding capacity in runtime, eng-platform, and devex. Target ~45 net new FTE in Q3: ~60% engineering, 25% product/ops, 15% growth/support. Prioritizing senior IC hires for infra.

Sahil (VP Eng): To add — bands mostly stayed the same but we tightened expectations for senior IC & EM roles. For hiring ops, default asks: runtime = L4/L5, product-facing = L3/L4. Exceptions need a short justification and @Maya sign-off.

Tom (ENG Manager - Runtime): Process q: what's the approval SLA for manager backfills? I have 3 spots that need to be filled quickly.

Maya (People Ops): Tom — managers should aim to approve backfills within 5 business days if they match the headcount plan. If you're bumping a role up a band, ping @Sahil with a 1-2 bullet justification (impact + budget).

Elliot (Recruiter): Heads up — sourcers start outreach next Mon for core infra roles. Please attach the hiring scorecard to Greenhouse reqs using this tag: `Infra_SrIC_Q3`. Also add interviewers to the panel early so we can schedule loops.

Lina (Hiring Manager - DevEx): On ramp question: what's the standard onboarding wave for L4-L5 hires? Can People Ops drop a checklist?

Maya (People Ops): Good ask — onboarding snippet below, will post full checklist in handbook:
```\nWeek 1: Hardware + Entitlements, org overview
Week 2: Team intro, small pairing task
Weeks 3-4: Deep pairing on codebase + infra walkthroughs
Weeks 5-8: Own a small feature/bug, regular 1:1 enablement
```
I'll push the checklist to /handbook/hiring by EOD.

Sahil (VP Eng): Internal mobility note: moves under 2 bands can use the internal transfer flow — no new req needed. Moves >=2 bands require ops approval. Managers: please document the growth plan in 2 bullets when requesting a move.

Jonas (CTO): Also clarifying messaging: this is a reallocation and ramp, not a hiring spree or cuts. For external recruiters, use "Q3 hiring ramp focused on infra and platform". Avoid wording that implies urgency like "aggressive hiring".

Tom (ENG Manager - Runtime): Cool. Any guidance on interview shadowing? I want my team to calibrate.

Sahil (VP Eng): Managers should participate in at least one loop in the first 4 interviews for their hires. We'll run a 30-min calibration session Monday 9am PT — invite to follow.

Elliot (Recruiter): I'll sync calendars and add calibration notes to the GH templates.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll summarize this thread and post a one-pager with links (scorecards, onboarding checklist, internal transfer flow) in the handbook by tomorrow morning. If you need quicker action, DM me.

hr-bot: New doc posted -> https://handbook.redwood.ai/hiring/q3-org-map (doc id: 234)

Lina (Hiring Manager - DevEx): Appreciate it — thanks everyone :heart:
